arch_pub_nbcDefs.new_text: RULE: NBC 2020 Div. A 1.4.1.2 definitions (local text l. 1444, 1477, 1815, 1901, 1983): 'Assembly occupancy (Group A) means the occupancy or the use of a building or part thereof by a gathering of persons for civic, political, travel, religious, social, educational, recreational or like purposes, or for the consumption of food or drink'; 'Building means any structure used or intended for supporting or sheltering any use or occupancy'; 'Mercantile occupancy (Group E) means the occupancy or use of a building or part thereof for the displaying or selling of retail goods, wares or merchandise'; 'Residential occupancy (Group C) means the occupancy or use of a building or part thereof by persons for whom sleeping accommodation is provided but who are not harboured for the purpose of receiving care or treatment and are not involuntarily detained'; 'Suite means a single room or series of rooms of complementary use, operated under a single tenancy ...'. Div. B 3.1.3.2.(2): 'Not more than one suite of residential occupancy shall be contained within a building classified as a Group F, Division 2 major occupancy.' (VBBL 2025 adds 'Except as permitted in Article 3.1.3.4. and 3.1.3.5., and Subsection 11.2.5.' — artist live/work and industrial flex space). 3.3.1.1.(1): each suite (other than business and personal services) separated from adjoining suites by not less than 1 h; 3.3.1.1.(3) exemptions in sprinklered buildings served by public corridors per 3.3.1.4.(4)(b), incl. 'suites of mercantile occupancy'. 3.3.5.4.(1) access from a storage garage to a stair tower or elevator serving occupancies above 'through a vestibule' (3.3.5.7.(4)); 3.3.5.4.(4) garage ventilation per 6.3.1 and 6.9.1.2; 3.3.5.6.(1) storage garage separated from other occupancies by not less than 1.5 h — data/raw/codes/nbc.txt ‖ CHECK 2 (2 Nov 2026, fixed): two definition quotes completed; Building definition, VBBL 3.1.3.2.(2) exception and 3.3.5.6 1.5 h added.
